title: Income Tax Act, 2025 to Replace 1961 Act from April 1, 2026 — 'PRARAMBH 2026' Launched
summary: FM Sitharaman launches PRARAMBH 2026 campaign and Income Tax Website 2.0 as India replaces the 65-year-old Income Tax Act 1961.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Income Tax Act, 2025 to Replace 1961 Act from April 1, 2026 — 'PRARAMBH 2026' Launched. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: FM Nirmala Sitharaman launched **'PRARAMBH 2026'** (Policy Reform and Responsible Action for Mission Viksit Bharat) and **Income Tax Website 2.0**, preparing taxpayers for the new Income Tax Act, 2025 taking effect **April 1, 2026**.
